projects.name: NYC Taxi Data Analysis
projects.description: Analyzed 99,999 valid taxi trips and 9,990 unique taxis using Python, PySpark, Spark SQL, and Pandas. Built Spark SQL queries with window functions and UDFs to calculate utilization and waiting-time metrics. Found 57% mean taxi utilization and a 7.0-minute median next-fare wait after Manhattan drop-offs.

projects.name: Multilingual Word Embeddings and Alignment
projects.description: Built an English-Spanish NLP pipeline to train, compare, and evaluate word representations on approximately 144,215 Tatoeba sentence pairs. Compared 5 representation methods across sparse and dense approaches. Used MUSE and Procrustes Analysis to align Spanish and English word embeddings. Achieved 0.88 water/agua cosine similarity, 0.99 F1 for language identification, and 0.91 F1 for Spanish sentiment classification.

projects.name: Zero-Shot Cross-Lingual Emotion Transfer
projects.description: Built a zero-shot cross-lingual emotion classification pipeline to transfer learning from English GoEmotions to Indonesian BRIGHTER without Indonesian training examples. Evaluated predictions using accuracy, Macro Precision, Macro Recall, and Macro F1. Best run reached 0.51 accuracy, 0.30 Macro Recall, and 0.26 Macro F1.

projects.name: Neural Style Transfer

projects.name: Pose-Guided Motion Transfer
